model.name: T-dnd-unknown-dispatcher: unknown format dropped onto room chat + extensible mimeType registry
model.description: When a dropped item format is unknown (not matched by any registered handler), dispatch it as a message to room chat. Extensible mimeType registry allows future handlers to claim specific formats. Covers R19.37.
model.supersededReason: SUBSUMED under Task 37.20 (the ONE DnD drop contract) — PO ruling 2026-09-07, R30.11 mint-to-shipped pattern (re-point to built reality, do not author paperwork). The Factory is gated GREEN via T37.39 Image (bc0302dd) + T37.40 CalendarEntry (257ab50f) per-class render. Implementation exists + is gated => subsumed by measurement, not built; no fresh ACs (they would prove nothing new).
